character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist in every scene: dark auburn hair in a loose braid, gentle brown eyes, with a distinct recognizable face and stable adult proportions. Their role in this world: a secondhand bookshop owner who remembers the story behind every donated book. Signature outfit: a soft mustard cardigan over a white blouse, dark skirt, and comfortable loafers. Defining personal object: a pencil tucked into a cloth bookmark embroidered with a tiny star. Preserve the same face, hair shape and color, eye color, body proportions, costume silhouette, and personal object throughout the entire music video.
consistency_rules: Use this exact protagonist as the sole lead throughout this theme.
Maintain consistent facial features, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the signature costume and defining object visually identical from scene to scene.
Do not replace the lead or add another protagonist unless explicitly demanded by the lyrics.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in narrow shelves to the ceiling, reading nook by the window, stacked crates outside the door; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with paper cream, leather brown, lamp amber, ink blue; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by slow tracking along towering shelves, close-up of aged pages and a bookmark, wide view of a cluttered shop interior; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
